text:
emma: quick smoke run of llm.int8 (bitsandbytes weight-only) on zephyr-14b. 1k prompts, seq=512, batch=1. posting raw numbers and notes.

emma: command:
```bash
python bench.py --model zephyr-14b --quant llmint8 --batch 1 --seq 512 --prompts 1000 --out ./runs/zephyr-lmint8
```

emma: results (median of warm+steady):
- fp16 baseline p50=148ms p95=320ms tokens/s=160
- llm.int8 weight-only p50=112ms p95=260ms tokens/s=230 (+1.44x)
- gptq 4-bit p50=106ms p95=280ms tokens/s=245 (+1.53x) but saw slight decode instability on long-form
- mem: fp16 GPU mem 35GB -> llmint8 20GB -> gptq 18GB
- eval (wikitext/qa slice): ppl fp16=12.8 -> llmint8=13.0 (+1.6%) -> gptq=13.3 (+3.9%)

emma: qualitatively llmint8 seems fine on short completions; gptq had a handful of truncated loops on long creative prompts.

raj: nice. can you paste the eval slices? wanting to check instruction-following and safety slices too.

emma: s3://redwood-evals/zephyr/1907654321/{llmint8,gptq,fp16}_metrics.json

sofia: did you try enabling nf4 or 8-bit caching? batch sizes for latency-sensitive RPCs?

emma: nf4 was the llmint8 default here. batches were 1; cpu prefetch on. try batch 4 improved throughput but p50 rose for single-request tail.

miguel: for Dedicated canary, we should prefer the llmint8 profile over gptq if quality delta <2% and mem savings are good. ops: add automatic fallback to fp16 on perplexity regression >2%.

ci-bot: perf-tests finished. artifacts: https://ci.internal/redwood/1907654321/bench-report.html :white_check_mark:

raj: any regressions on safety evals?

emma: safety slice pass rate: fp16 99.1% -> llmint8 98.9% -> gptq 97.6% (so within threshold for llmint8)

sofia: did you run with kv-cache warm-up? some llmint8 kernels are sensitive to cold cache.

emma: warm-up=32 tokens used. re-ran cold-start and saw p50 +8ms; will include in next run.

miguel: plan: 1) extended eval on QA/legal/longform 2) small canary on dedicated-2 pool with llmint8 profile + automated rollback 3) add prompt-level regression alerts (delta >1% ppl or qa accuracy drop >1%)

emma: creating issue: https://rwd/issue/INF-2317 capturing results and canary plan. assigning @raj @sofia @miguel

raj: thanks, assigning me to eval slice cleanup.

sofia: i'll test batching and nf4 vs 8bit-cache knobs, and run with different seq lengths (512/1024/2048).

emma: filing a short doc with run commands and raw CSV in the s3 path. will post when done. :thumbsup:
